title: Main page and control panel
author: claude
summary: The page itself, with five camera views, Day and Evening buttons, and sliders.
what: The main page holds the 3D scene, five camera views (hero, front, window, top and low), Day and Evening buttons, and the sliders.
why: We need to look at the room from useful angles and change settings quickly.
how: The camera has a narrow 30 degree lens, Neutral tone mapping and shadows on. The sliders come from leva.
